scripts.install:all: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefix frontend/public-client && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefix frontend/admin-client && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefix server
scripts.format: prettier --write README.md package.json compose.yaml .github/workflows/*.yml ci/*.mjs docs/*.md frontend/**/*.{html,css,js,json,md} server/dist/**/*.js server/scripts/**/*.js server/package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md package.json compose.yaml .github/workflows/*.yml ci/*.mjs docs/*.md frontend/**/*.{html,css,js,json,md} server/dist/**/*.js server/scripts/**/*.js server/package.json
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run verify:frontends && npm run verify:backend
